content.text: Two enterprise tenants confirmed failure limited to support.example.com while app.example.com SSO works.
Customer SSO login succeeds on the main app domain but fails only on the support portal subdomain with a generic authentication error.
ACS URL configuration for the portal subdomain appears out of sync with the identity provider metadata customers download from example.com docs.
Align portal SAML endpoints with the documented ACS URLs, improve error messages for ACS mismatch, and provide a self-serve metadata check.
